name: minerals-oracle-x402
description: High-performance Web3 x402 critical raw minerals, COMEX/LME arbitrage spreads, and urban-mining scrap yield oracle for autonomous AI agents on Polygon.

tools.name: get_mineral_prices
tools.description: Retrieve all certified spot prices (Silver, Platinum, Copper, Lithium, Rare Earths) with unit conversions (USD/oz, USD/kg, USD/mt).

tools.name: get_arbitrage_spreads
tools.description: Calculate locational arbitrage and basis spreads (COMEX vs LME Copper, COMEX vs LBMA Silver, SMM China vs CIF Rotterdam Lithium).

tools.name: calculate_urban_mining_value
tools.description: Calculate theoretical and payable recovery value for recyclable scrap (EV Battery Black Mass, Auto Catalysts, E-Waste PCB, Wind Permanent Magnets).

tools.name: get_onchain_signed_feed
tools.description: Generate an EIP-712 cryptographically signed price feed payload and raw ABI calldata (v, r, s) for Solidity smart contracts and AggregatorV3 on Polygon.
